description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing private links associated with event types, including creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting private links.

classes.name: EventTypesPrivateLinksController
classes.description: Controller handling CRUD operations for private links related to event types.

methods.name: createPrivateLink
methods.description: Creates a new private link for a specified event type.

methods.name: getPrivateLinks
methods.description: Retrieves all private links for a specified event type.

methods.name: updatePrivateLink
methods.description: Updates an existing private link for a specified event type.

methods.name: deletePrivateLink
methods.description: Deletes a private link for a specified event type.
